name: pokebonk-desktop
description: Cliente de escritorio de PokéBonk (fan-game no oficial, gratuito y sin ánimo de lucro).
author: Charcher

scripts.dist:linux:docker: npm run build && docker run --rm -v "%INIT_CWD%:/project" -v /project/node_modules -w /project electronuserland/builder:22 bash -c "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx electron-builder --linux -c.directories.output=/tmp/rel && cp /tmp/rel/*.AppImage /tmp/rel/*.deb /project/release/"
